legacy_cells.B: Selective Diabetic Retinopathy Screening with Accuracy-Weighted Deep Ensembles and Entropy-Guided Abstention
legacy_cells.I: 012_2025_Selective Diabetic Retinopathy Screening with Accuracy-Weighted Deep Ensembles and Entropy-Guided Abstention.pdf
legacy_cells.S: Classify retinal fundus images as no diabetic retinopathy versus presence of diabetic retinopathy, with low-confidence predictions excluded or flagged for review.
legacy_cells.AJ: ResNet-50; DenseNet-121; MobileNetV3-Small; MobileNetV3-Large; EfficientNet-B0; EfficientNet-B2; EfficientNet-B3
legacy_cells.DQ: Over 35,000 retinal fundus images; approximately 26,000 training, 5,000 validation, and 5,000 testing images
legacy_cells.FM: Authors report an accuracy-weighted ensemble of seven CNN architectures and a probability-weighted entropy method for sample-level uncertainty and selective prediction.
legacy_cells.FN: Accuracy-weighted ensemble: unfiltered test accuracy 93.70% and F1 0.9376. At entropy threshold 0.38, filtered accuracy 99.44% and F1 0.9932; 69.2% of test samples were excluded.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors state that reliance on EyePACS may limit generalizability; binary classification omits severity-grading detail; uncertainty filtering excludes many samples; independent external validation and clinical trials are lacking; generalization across devices and populations is not guaranteed.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose cross-dataset validation, fairness assessment across demographics, workflow integration, longitudinal clinical evaluation, multi-class severity classification, and multimodal clinical data.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify limited integration of uncertainty quantification within ensemble frameworks for medical imaging.
legacy_cells.FR: Demonstrates image-level diabetic-retinopathy classification and selective abstention on an internal EyePACS split, not a persistent patient/procedural state, temporal transition, action-conditioned forecast, identified treatment effect, counterfactual rollout, or planning/control; no prospective clinical validation is reported.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M7 Outcome & causal layer; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Place selective rejection after calibrated predictions and report the accuracy–coverage trade-off before allowing automatic output.
legacy_cells.FX: Full extracted PDF text, pages 1–8: title and abstract; introduction and related work; methods including preprocessing, dataset split, CNN training, ensemble and entropy thresholding; results and Tables I–III; discussion, limitations/future work and conclusion; reproducibility/implementation details, ethics considerations, and references. Relevant numeric tables were legible in the extracted text; no unreadable-table issue encountered. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I preserved; no PDF-based bibliographic correction. Evidence supports a static image-classification/abstention method, not a temporal/action world model; reported performance is internal EyePACS held-out evaluation. No external browsing or workbook edits. Evidence QA: 1/41 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (2.4%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 40 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 2 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.
